description: Source code for an ARP monitor component in the prplMesh project, handling ARP table reading, ARP packet sending, and processing netlink messages related to neighbor (ARP) entries.

classes.name: arp_monitor
classes.description: Class managing ARP monitoring, including socket handling, ARP table reading, and packet processing.

methods.name: read_arp_table
methods.description: Reads the ARP table via netlink socket and fills a vector with neighbor entries.

methods.name: send_arp
methods.description: Constructs and sends an ARP request packet on a specified interface.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes sockets and netlink connection to start ARP monitoring on a given interface.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Closes sockets and cleans up resources used for ARP monitoring.

methods.name: process_mon
methods.description: Processes netlink messages to retrieve neighbor (ARP) events.

methods.name: process_arp
methods.description: Processes received ARP packets to match probes and update ARP data.

methods.name: probe
methods.description: Sends an ARP request to probe a specific MAC/IP address.

methods.name: get_mac_for_ip
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address for a given IP from the ARP table.

methods.name: get_ip_for_mac
methods.description: Retrieves IP address for a given MAC from the ARP table.
